question: A friend of mine got hired as a summer intern after I put her name forward. Do I get a bonus for that, and if it had been a permanent job, when would the bonus be paid?

sources.quote: Contract or temporary roles, including Internships, are not eligible for referral bonuses.
We offer a referral bonus once the new team member has been employed with the company for 3 months.

note: Hiring says intern roles earn no referral bonus; Total Rewards says a normal referral bonus is paid once the hire has been employed 3 months.

check.reason: Not cross: total-rewards/incentives.md alone says 'no bonus if the referral is an intern' and gives the 3-month payout, so hiring adds nothing the other section lacks.

question: I started in mid-November. Will I be part of the stock top-up in this year's pay review, and if I get a raise, what date does it start?

sources.quote: October 5th to be eligible to participate in the equity refresh program
Your salary will be increased to (insert $ amount in local currency) which is a (insert %) adjustment effective, February 1st.

note: Total Rewards sets an October 5 hire-date cut-off for the equity refresh (so a November starter is out); Leadership's review script says raises take effect February 1.

check.reason: Raise date conflicts: total-rewards says new compensation from the annual review is effective May 1 (compensation/_index.md, review-cycle diagram), while the leadership script says February 1; no single correct answer.

question: If I'm keeping time for the chief executive as his shadow, how long should a meeting that is booked for an hour actually run?

sources.quote: Understand meeting length. Use the calendar invite as an indication of how long the meeting should last.

question: I bought a book from the leaders' recommended reading list about four months ago and never claimed it. Can I still get the money back?

sources.quote: expense claims over 90 days from purchase date will not be reimbursed unless approved by your Manager

note: Leadership says reading-list books can be expensed; Finance says claims older than 90 days need the manager's approval.

check.reason: Not cross: finance/expenses.md already says books are reimbursable when used for the job, and finance holds the 90-day rule, so leadership contributes no part finance lacks.

question: In an interview I felt the candidate just wouldn't fit in with our culture, so I'm leaning toward the strongest possible no. Is culture fit what we should judge, and what usually happens to a candidate who gets that vote?

sources.quote: We want a **values fit**, not a culture fit.
Candidates who receive a Strong No vote should almost always be rejected immediately by the hiring manager.

note: Values says to judge values fit, not culture fit; Hiring says a Strong No almost always leads to immediate rejection.

check.reason: Not cross: hiring/interviewing/customer-support-interviewing.md also says managers assess values fit rather than culture fit, so hiring alone answers both parts.

question: How big is the pay-rise budget for the fiscal year that ends in January 2027, and on what date do raises from that review take effect?

sources.quote: "FY20" is the preferred format and means: Fiscal Year 2020, the period running from February 1, 2019 through January 31, 2020
Our annual cash compensation review budget for FY27 is funded at 3.5% of TTC (Total Target Cash) for all countries except for India which is funded at 7% to better align to market.
Your salary will be increased to (insert $ amount in local currency) which is a (insert %) adjustment effective, February 1st.

note: Communication's naming rule maps the year ending January 2027 to FY27; Total Rewards gives the FY27 budget (3.5%, 7% in India); Leadership says raises take effect February 1.

check.reason: Raise date conflicts (total-rewards says May 1, leadership says Feb 1). Without that part only one budget exists in the corpus, so the fiscal-year mapping is not needed and the item is no longer cross.

question: Who do I contact to file an anti-harassment complaint?
note: Searched all 8 held sections (product, finance, total-rewards, leadership, hiring, communication, values, ceo), case-insensitive regex. Close to covered: communication/_index.md and values/_index.md link to the Anti-Harassment Policy in people-group (not held) and values says harassment is not tolerated. 'harassment': 4 hits, all links/statements, no contact; 'hotline|EthicsPoint|Navex|speak ?up': hits are a Singapore health hotline and generic 'speak up' advice; 'complaint': only ceo/shadow.md (shadows do not attend meetings about anonymous complaints).

check.reason: Not clearly absent: the corpus names Team Member Relations and teammemberrelations@gitlab.com as the people-issues contact (leadership/coaching.md, leadership/underperformance.md, NZ benefits page), so 'contact Team Member Relations' is a defensible grounded answer.
